jobs.title: Marketing Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
TL;DR We’re hiring a Marketing Strategy Lead to turn Listen’s market POV, customer insights, and company strategy into executive-ready stories, decks, thought leadership, and content programs.

This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, storytelling, and execution. You’ll work directly with our Head of Marketing and leadership team to shape how Listen explains the category, packages our point of view, and brings big ideas to market through high-quality presentations, content series, webinars, and market narratives.

This role is for someone who is structured, polished, and has high-taste. Someone who can take a messy idea, find the sharpest story, turn it into a clear deck or content program, and keep improving it based on audience engagement and business impact.

This is a senior IC role with high ownership. You’ll help build the strategy and storytelling muscle behind Listen’s marketing engine.

Min. 4–7 years in B2B SaaS marketing, product marketing, strategy, consulting, or related roles. Prior marketing experience is required. Management consulting experience or experience at a scaling startup is a plus.





BACKGROUND

Listen Labs is the world's fastest AI research platform, built so every company can understand what their customers want, why, and what to do about it. Our AI conducts in-depth interviews, analyzes conversations, and delivers executive-ready insights in hours, not weeks. Born out of a Harvard research project, Listen is trusted by teams at leading brands like Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Perplexity, Sweetgreen, Replit, and Nestlé to bring real customer voices into their biggest product, marketing, and growth decisions.




COMPANY HIGHLIGHTS:

 - World-Class Team: Founded by serial entrepreneurs — Alfred (Bemlo, YC W22) and Florian (IOI medalist, ICPC World Finalist) — and built with talent from Google, Meta, Tesla, Amazon, Jane Street, and X, alongside Bain, Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, and Sequoia-backed startups like Applied Intuition, Scale AI, and Rippling. Over 30% of our team are former founders, and multiple are competitive programming medalists.

 - Hypergrowth: Since launching, Listen has grown annualized revenue 15x and completed over 2 million interviews — backed by $100M in total funding led by Ribbit Capital, with Sequoia, Conviction, and Pear VC participating.

 - Traction: Already serving 15% of Fortune 100s. Enterprise wins and expansions across Anthropic, Microsoft, Nestlé, Perplexity, Sweetgreen, and more — with teams telling us research that used to take six to eight weeks now happens in days.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own strategic marketing projects

 - Build executive-ready decks for leadership, webinars, events, thought leadership, customer conversations, and major marketing moments.

 - Develop thought leadership programs that turn customer insights, product momentum, and market trends into strong external-facing content.

 - Own and scale content series, webinars, and recurring formats that educate the market and engage our audience.

 - Use performance data and audience feedback to understand what resonates and improve the next version.
   
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - You are an excellent storyteller with strong strategic instincts and great taste.

 - You can take ambiguous inputs, structure the thinking, and turn them into a crisp narrative, deck, or content program.

 - You have prior marketing experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, enterprise software, product marketing, or a high-growth startup.

 - You are polished and executive-ready, with the judgment to work directly with founders, leaders, customers, and cross-functional teams.

 - You like building repeatable processes and improving them over time.

 - You are comfortable operating as a senior IC in an early-stage environment.

 - You have the taste to know when something is too generic, too dense, too fluffy, or not yet ready.
   
   


YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF

 - You enjoy turning messy ideas into clear stories that help people understand why something matters.

 - You’ve worked in product marketing, content strategy, marketing strategy, management consulting, or a strategy role at a high-growth startup.

 - You are excited by the idea of building the strategic storytelling function at one of the fastest-growing AI companies in customer understanding.
   
   


LIFE AT LISTEN

 - Health, covered: Full medical, dental, and vision. FSA/HSA and life insurance are available too.

 - Competitive compensation: Backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, Ribbit Capital, Conviction, and Pear VC — we hire the best and treat them accordingly, with meaningful equity ownership.

 - Annual Learning Stipend: Books, courses, conferences, coaching, language lessons — almost anything that makes you sharper.

 - Annual Wellness Stipend for your health and headspace: Gym memberships, race fees, massages, ergonomic gear, and more.

 - Monthly Stipend for AI tools: A dedicated budget for the software and GPU credits that make you faster.

 - Fed, daily: A private chef serves lunch and dinner in our SF office; NYC and London teams get daily meal credit.

 - Flexible time off: A take-what-you-need vacation policy.

 - We celebrate together: Company offsites (Hawaii this Summer!) and events like our annual holiday party — every win is a team win.

 - Room to grow: As an early member of the team, you'll own end-to-end processes from scratch and grow alongside the company.

jobs.title: Founding Experiential Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
TL;DR: We’re hiring our Founding Experiential Marketing Lead to work directly with our Head of Marketing and help scale Listen from $XXM → $100M+ ARR. You’ll help shape how our brand shows up in the world by creating events and experiences that people genuinely want to be part of — from standout moments at major industry conferences to intimate dinners, customer gatherings, and entirely new event concepts. This is a high-ownership role for someone who combines taste, creativity, and exceptional execution and wants to build something from 0-1 at a breakout company in the AI era.

Min. 4+ years in experiential marketing, events, brand experiences, field marketing, or related roles. You don't need to come from a traditional SaaS events background — we care more about your creative judgment, track record of producing memorable experiences, and ability to turn an idea into reality. You should be equally comfortable dreaming up a new concept, sweating the details, and getting in the weeds to make it happen. Excitement about travel and working in a fast-paced startup environment is important.







BACKGROUND 

Listen Labs is the world's fastest AI research platform, built so every company can understand what their customers want, why, and what to do about it. Our AI conducts in-depth interviews, analyzes conversations, and delivers executive-ready insights in hours, not weeks. Born out of a Harvard research project, Listen is trusted by teams at leading brands like Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Perplexity, Sweetgreen, Replit, and Nestlé to bring real customer voices into their biggest product, marketing, and growth decisions.




COMPANY HIGHLIGHTS

 - World-Class Team: Founded by serial entrepreneurs — Alfred (Bemlo, YC W22) and Florian (IOI medalist, ICPC World Finalist) — and built with talent from Google, Meta, Tesla, Amazon, Jane Street, and X, alongside Bain, Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, and Sequoia-backed startups like Applied Intuition, Scale AI, and Rippling. Over 30% of our team are former founders, and multiple are competitive programming medalists.

 - Hypergrowth: Since launching, Listen has grown annualized revenue 15x and completed over 2 million interviews — backed by $100M in total funding led by Ribbit Capital, with Sequoia, Conviction, and Pear VC participating.

 - Traction: Already serving 15% of Fortune 100s. Enterprise wins and expansions across Anthropic, Microsoft, Nestlé, Perplexity, Sweetgreen, and more — with teams telling us research that used to take six to eight weeks now happens in days.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Partner with the Head of Marketing to shape Listen’s experiential and events strategy, defining how we show up in the market and building a distinctive event presence from the ground up.

 - Reimagine how Listen shows up at industry conferences, elevating booth presence, speaking moments, sponsorships, and adjacent experiences so every appearance feels unmistakably Listen and gives people a reason to seek us out.

 - Create and produce owned experiences from scratch, from intimate dinners and customer roundtables to salons, pop-ups, cultural moments, and larger brand experiences. Develop formats people genuinely want to attend — not just another corporate event.

 - Build the playbook for Listen’s events program, establishing repeatable concepts, creative standards, production processes, and measurement frameworks while leaving room to experiment and try new things.

 - Partner closely with sales, product marketing, design, and leadership to bring experiences to life and ensure they ladder up to broader campaigns, customer priorities, and business goals.

 - Own the details from concept to execution, including venues, vendors, budgets, creative, guest lists, programming, production, and on-site execution.

 - Measure performance, gather learnings, and continuously raise the bar on what we do — doubling down on what works and killing what doesn't.
   
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have taste. You have a strong POV on what makes an experience memorable and know how to create moments that feel fresh, unexpected, and distinctly on-brand.

 - You’re a builder. You’re excited by the opportunity to create a 0-1 events and experiential function rather than inherit an established playbook.

 - You’re a strong operator. You can manage dozens of moving pieces without losing quality, and you're the person who catches the detail everyone else missed.

 - You know how to create energy. You understand what makes people want to show up, stay, connect, and talk about an experience afterward.

 - You’re creatively ambitious but scrappy. You can dream up the big idea, then figure out how to make it happen with the resources you have.

 - You’re commercially minded. You care about pipeline, customer relationships, brand impact, and business outcomes — not just attendance numbers or event logistics.

 - You’re highly collaborative and low-ego. You can work across sales, marketing, design, product, and leadership and bring people together around a shared vision.

 - You’re comfortable being hands-on. You’re just as willing to negotiate with a vendor or fix something on-site as you are to pitch the big creative concept.

 - You’re excited to travel. You want to be in the field representing Listen and creating experiences in the real world.

 - You have 4+ years of relevant experience in experiential marketing, events, brand experiences, field marketing, or a related discipline. Experience in B2B SaaS is a plus, but not required.
   
   


LIFE AT LISTEN LABS

 - Competitive compensation: Backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, Ribbit Capital, Conviction, and Pear VC — we hire the best and treat them accordingly, with meaningful equity ownership.
   
   - The range for this role is $150,000 – $300,000 OTE. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, experience, and work location. If this range doesn't match your expectations, we still encourage you to apply.

 - Annual Learning Stipend: Books, courses, conferences, coaching, language lessons — almost anything that makes you sharper.

 - Flexible time off: A take-what-you-need vacation policy.

 - We celebrate together: Company offsites (Hawaii this Summer!) and events like our annual holiday party — every win is a team win.

 - Room to grow: As an early member of the team, you'll own end-to-end processes from scratch and grow alongside the company.

jobs.title: Business Development Lead
jobs.description:

Reporting to the VP of Revenue, you’ll be responsible for coaching a team of highly driven BDRs across outbound, warm signal follow-up, conference motions, and relationship-driven pipeline creation. WHAT YOU’LL DO




TEAM LEADERSHIP & COACHING

 - Manage and develop a team of BDRs across outbound, warm signal follow-up, conference motions, and early qualification

 - Run weekly team cadences around account prioritization, pipeline reviews, messaging refinement, and conversion performance

 - Coach reps on cold calling, personalization, objection handling, multi-threading, and live event networking

 - Build a high-accountability culture centered on speed, craft, experimentation, and consistent execution


PLAYBOOKS, SYSTEMS & PROCESS

 - Build and operationalize repeatable outbound plays across a variety of channels

 - Create clear workflows for pre-event prep, post-event follow-up, call blocks, and account queue ownership

PIPELINE PERFORMANCE & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

 - Own team performance across meetings sourced, qualified pipeline, conversion rates, and play-level effectiveness

 - Work closely with AEs on account coverage, multi-threading, and strategic account penetration

 - Partner with founders, Growth, PMM, and Product to bring field learnings back into messaging and GTM strategy

 - Fast-moving: You thrive in ambiguous startup environments where the motion is evolving in real time

 - Cross-functional: You work well with founders, Growth, PMM, and Sales leadership to align on priorities and raise the team’s ceiling

 
 


REQUIREMENTS

jobs.title: Founding EMEA Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
TL;DR

We're hiring our first dedicated marketer in EMEA. You'll shape how Listen shows up in Europe and build the demand engine behind it as we scale across the UK, Nordics, DACH France, and beyond.

This is a founding role. You'll be our first marketing hire outside the US, working alongside our rapidly growing EMEA GTM and Post-sale teams to grow the accounts we have and land the next sets. The dominant motion in year one is field and demand: conferences, executive dinners, roundtables, webinars, and targeted campaigns.

You'll pick the rooms, build the programs that fill them, coordinate the follow-up, and wire it all up so we know what's working by the end of each quarter. This is a senior IC role with real ownership.

Min. 4 years in B2B SaaS marketing with real demand gen or field experience, ideally both. Knowledge of enterprise sales cycles required. Hands-on with marketing systems required. Having built a regional or category motion from an early stage is a strong plus.




BACKGROUND - GTM

Listen Labs is the world's fastest AI research platform, built so every company can understand what their customers want, why, and what to do about it. Our AI conducts in-depth interviews, analyzes conversations, and delivers executive-ready insights in hours, not weeks. Born out of a Harvard research project, Listen is trusted by teams at leading brands like Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Perplexity, Sweetgreen, Replit, and Nestlé to bring real customer voices into their biggest product, marketing, and growth decisions.




COMPANY HIGHLIGHTS:

 - World-Class Team: Founded by serial entrepreneurs, former co-founders, and talent from Jane Street, Twitter, Stripe, Rippling, Affirm, Bain, Goldman Sachs, and many more, plus IOI/ICPC backgrounds.

 - Hypergrowth: We're a 90-person team backed by Sequoia, growing from $0 to mid $XXM run-rate in under a year. We move fast, care deeply about craft, and love working with people who take ownership.

 - Europe is already working: Several of the world's largest brands run their global research programs on Listen, including across their European teams. EMEA is where we’ll put dedicated weight behind demand that's already there.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Sharpen Listen's story for European buyers. We hold the enterprise certifications and data residency commitments this market expects. Your job is making sure that part of the pitch lands.

 - Bring the best US programs to the region, and have the judgment to know which ones don't translate.

 - Own the field calendar end to end. Which conferences we show up at, what we do there, and the executive dinners and roundtables that put our European customers in a room with our best prospects.

 - Run the demand programs around that calendar. Account-based campaigns against named targets, webinars, email nurture, and the follow-up in the four weeks after every event. Partner with our growth team on EMEA-specific paid campaigns

 - Create the content and brand moments that carry Listen in-region. Localized case studies, launch videos, blog and newsletter content, founder LinkedIn content, and scrappy brand stunts like a first EMEA OOH campaign.

 - Build out the regional engine on top of our existing GTM stack. Segmentation, lists, routing, follow-up sequences, attribution, and a dashboard that tells you and the sales team the truth.

 - Build Listen's community in EMEA, bringing European researchers, insights and marketing leaders together around Listen.
   
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - You've worked inside a B2B marketing engine and understand how the parts connect. You can look at a funnel and say where it's leaking.

 - You want the version of this job where you build the region and put your name on it.

 - You're hands-on with the systems. CRM, marketing automation, enrichment, attribution. You build the campaign yourself rather than waiting for ops.

 - You're proactive to the point of impatience. You see the gap and start closing it before anyone assigns it.

 - You can create as well as operate. Comfortable writing content and shaping brand moments, and fluent enough in paid to steer it with the growth team
   
   


YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF

 - You're excited to build the European presence of one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world.

 - You've been the first marketer in a region before, or you've seen it done and know what you'd do differently.

 - You want to set the regional strategy rather than execute a calendar someone else built.
